meta.notes: Built from the live production site roguetrader.owlcat.games. Fonts and colours are [observed] — extracted directly from the site's stylesheets (main-landing.css, variables.css) rather than browser screenshots (the Chrome capture path was unavailable, so static assets were pulled instead — arguably higher fidelity: real font names + real pixel hex values). Logo, gilded frame, dividers, weapon SKU art and the companions key-art were downloaded as images. Real type: Stevens Titling Pro Badger Brush (display gold caps), TT Supermolot Neue Reg/Med/Demibold (condensed grotesque UI), Open Sans (body). Google-Fonts proxies chosen for the webstore (licensed faces unavailable): Cinzel <- Stevens Titling Pro (imperial Roman titling), Oswald <- TT Supermolot Neue (condensed grotesque), Open Sans is on Google Fonts directly. Primary green (#72a846/#548031) is the site's preorder CTA colour; gold/parchment and warp-green are observed accents. Status colours are [inferred]: statusPositive is shifted lime to stay distinguishable from the green primary (primary is also greenish) and MUST carry a non-colour cue; statusNegative blood-red is 40K-canonical but not used on the marketing site.

essence.positioning: Command your dynasty across the Koronus Expanse — gilded authority and gothic grandeur in the unending war of the 41st Millennium.

artStyle.subStyle: grimdark gothic sci-fi (grim-baroque) with gilded metallic ornament
renderingCues: dramatic chiaroscuro; cool desaturated environments with warm rim-lit characters
warp-green energy VFX (lightning arcs, glowing orbs, xenos haze)
gilded / bronze metallic ornament and inscriptional titling
atmospheric depth, cathedral-of-the-void backdrops, painterly brushwork

primary.usage: Military-green primary CTA (site preorder colour); buttons, active states

secondary.usage: Imperial gold — ornament, hairline frames, accents, badges

tertiary.usage: Warp-green VFX glow accent — highlights, glows, energy

neutral.usage: Warm taupe foundation seed; ramp yields bone/parchment lights and void-brown shadows

statusPositive.usage: Success / confirmed — MUST also carry icon+label (primary is also greenish)

contrastRules: Light-on-dark is the default: parchment/bone (#e8dd9c) or pure white on void-black (#0c0a0a) — ~14–19:1.
Gold #d1a974 on void-black ≈ 8.4:1 — safe for large text and ornament; acceptable for body but prefer parchment for long copy.
Primary green buttons use near-black text (#0c0a0a) on #72a846 ≈ 7.4:1 — never white-on-green (fails).
Place the logo/type only inside a darkened scrim or isolation panel when over busy key-art — never directly on high-detail painterly backgrounds.
Gold hairline frames separate content from art; never let parchment text touch un-scrimmed illustration.

scale.pairingRationale: Oswald's condensed militaristic grotesque carries UI headings/SKU titles/prices (matches the site's TT Supermolot Neue); Open Sans gives neutral, legible body (the site's real body face); Cinzel reserves imperial Roman gold-titling grandeur for hero/wordmark moments.

heading-display.effect: gold metallic gradient fill on hero (Cinzel)

typography.reversedTypeRule: Default is reversed (light-on-dark): headings sit at bold+; for parchment body on void-black keep regular but never below 14px. Letterspace CAPS labels +0.08–0.1em; never letterspace lowercase.

lightingModel.interactiveElements: elevation-level-1 + gold hairline border + higher saturation; warm rim/sheen on hover
lightingModel.nonInteractiveElements: elevation-flat + subtle parchment/void fill + no shadow + no overlay
lightingModel.vfxSignature: warp-green energy glow (radial), gilded edge-light, lightning arcs, atmospheric void haze

accessibility.statusNotByColourAlone: positive=check icon+label, caution=triangle icon, negative=cross/skull icon — required because primary and statusPositive are both greenish
accessibility.focusRing: gold ring on every focusable element
accessibility.notes: Avoid white-on-green (fails ~2:1). Use near-black text on green CTAs.

distress.rule: subtle metallic wear on gold ornament/edges only; never on body text; low-contrast value change

texture.other: parchment-grain on light panels; gilded filigree frames + corner fittings as the signature ornament layer

motion.interactiveFeedback: scale 0.98 on press; gold-glow on hover; warp-green pulse behind featured CTAs

assetPrompts.heroBanner: Grimdark Warhammer 40,000 painterly key art, 16:9 cinematic banner: a Rogue Trader noble in an ornate black-and-gold longcoat commanding a retinue (space marine, psyker with warp-lightning, xenos foes) aboard a gothic void-ship bridge; cool desaturated cathedral environment, warm rim-light on heroes, glowing warp-green energy orb, atmospheric haze; dramatic chiaroscuro, gilded ornament, painterly digital illustration; leave a darker scrim zone on the left third for the gold inscriptional logo.
assetPrompts.skuArt: Single Warhammer 40,000 item render on transparent/void background, portrait 2:3: ornate gilded bolt weapon / relic / supply crate with Imperial aquila engraving, battle-worn metal, bronze and gold trim, subtle warp-green glow rim-light, painterly stylized-realism, centred, dramatic top-right key light.
assetPrompts.background: Seamless dark gothic-tech texture tile: near-black void (#0c0a0a) with faint engraved gold filigree, rivets and aquila motifs at very low contrast, subtle parchment grain and 4% noise; must not compete with foreground content.

codashop.architectureNote: 5-tier cascade: (1) type primitives + ref seeds -> (2) palette ramps (--x-palette-{role}-500 = --x-ref-{role}) -> (3) sys intensity / dimensions / effects / states -> (4) semantic defaults (--x-bg-*, --x-text-*, --x-border-*) -> (5) .text-style-* classes. Figma token exports drop the --x- prefix; repo names always include it. emitter.ts injects only Tier 1 ref seeds + optional Tier 2 ramps + font + --x-bg-page. Tiers 3-4 auto-resolve downstream and are store-overridable. THREE override layers: SYSTEM CONSTANT (layoutSystem + the 27 textStyle compositions + scales — never change) > BRAND-LOCKED (ref seeds, font, size values, brandCharacter) > STORE-FLEXIBLE (semantic colour mapping, component variants). NOTE for this repo: the live token vars use the NON-prefixed form (--ref-*, --sys-*, --palette-*, --bg-*, --text-*, --border-*, --gap-*, --radius-*) — strip the --x- when writing src/tokens/ds/themes/roguetrader.css.

layoutSystem.containerRule: device screen sets container-type:inline-size; overlay must NOT (traps position:fixed)

spanVariants.content: full width on XS/S; centred cols 3-10 of 12, max-width 960px, on M/L
spanVariants.carousel: full-bleed on XS/S (negative margin cancels grid margin); content on M/L

layoutSystem.tokenTierDiscipline: components consume ONLY semantic (--x-bg-*, --x-text-*, --x-border-*) + spacing/size (--x-pad-*, --x-gap-*, --x-radius-*, --x-size-*); NEVER --x-sys-*, --x-palette-*, or --x-ref-* directly
layoutSystem.mobileDesktopRule: values switch at breakpoints via -desktop- token twins: --x-sys-space-desktop-*, --x-sys-radius-desktop-*, --x-sys-size-control-desktop-*, --x-text-size-desktop-*

palette.anchorRule: --x-palette-{role}-500 resolves to --x-ref-{role} — the 500 step IS the seed

semanticDefaults._note: Every mapping below is store-overridable. Tag them as suggestions, not requirements.

buttonPrimary.feel: imperial command — solid, weighty, gilded-edged; unmistakably the primary action
buttonPrimary.colourDepthNote: primary-main green bg + near-black text; optional gold hairline border; stores may invert to gold-on-dark

buttonSecondary.feel: supporting, restrained — a gilded outline that defers to the primary

card.feel: gilded reliquary panel — dark surface bound by a thin gold hairline

badge.feel: imperial seal / purity stamp — compact, angular, high-visibility

input.feel: engraved field — clearly editable, gold hairline on dark

modal.feel: a sealed council chamber — focused, elevated, gold-framed over a void scrim

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Gilded filigree frame
tier2SignatureSurfaces.surface: Featured/hero panels, SKU cards, section containers
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: Thin gold double-hairline border (1px outer + 1px inner inset via box-shadow) with small corner ornament fittings. Use border:1px solid var(--border-default) + box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(209,169,116,0.18); optional corner SVG/border-image from the site's frame.png motif. Radius --sys-radius-s.
tier2SignatureSurfaces.precedentFile: src/components/**/SkuCard.vue, SectionHeader.vue (apply via theme tokens only — no per-store component branch)

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Warp-green VFX glow
tier2SignatureSurfaces.surface: Behind featured key-art, best-seller hero, primary CTAs on hover
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: Radial green glow: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(161,233,103,0.35), transparent 70%) as a ::before layer, or box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(161,233,103,0.4). Drives the --x-sys-effect-glow-primary tint.

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Inscriptional gold-gradient title
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: Cinzel caps with metallic gold gradient fill: background: linear-gradient(180deg,#f3e3b0,#d1a974 45%,#8a6e3f); -webkit-background-clip:text; color:transparent; subtle text-shadow for bevel. Reserve for heading-display-hero only.

tier2SignatureSurfaces.name: Centre-medallion divider
tier2SignatureSurfaces.implementation: Horizontal gold hairline rules flanking a central aquila/sunburst medallion (the site's main-line-left/right.png + emblem). 1px gradient rule fading to transparent at the medallion. Decorative only.
